findings.statement: T.N. Kaul, in 'Gems of Kashmiri Literature', states that some critics wrongly attributed one of Arinimaal's most pathetic ditties, 'åríní rang gom shràvan híyè', to her contemporary Mahmud Gami (1765–1855).
Amin Kamil wrote that Mahmud Gaami is a historical fact and Arinimaal a conceived character.

Azad said that the poem 'åríní rang gom shràvan híyè' reflects the emotions of Mrs. Bhawani Das; in a separate attribution, he assumed the poem 'kävi víhínúm aríníní …' to be that of Munshi Bhawani Das.
